title: Smart People Are Loading Up on AI Skills Right Now
metaDescription: New research shows what's actually happening in the job market. People with AI skills are pulling ahead while everyone else falls behind.
author: Marty @ CertFlo

sections.heading: What's Actually Happening in the Job Market
sections.body: Researchers at the London School of Economics just looked at 650 million hiring records and found something nobody saw coming: work-from-home policies are hitting entry-level hiring harder than AI automation. Business Insider covered it this week. Here's the thing though. While everyone's been freaking out about AI taking jobs, the smart people have been quietly figuring out AI. They saw the real play while everyone else was worried about the wrong stuff. There's a window open right now. idk how long it stays that way.

sections.heading: Why This Is Actually Your Biggest Shot
sections.body:
Think about what's really going on. Companies are hiring fewer junior people cause remote training is harder. But they still need the work done. They still need to get ahead. They still need results.

That's where AI comes in. The people who can deliver AI-powered results are becoming the ones companies can't live without. Traditional entry-level hiring is slowing down but demand is exploding for people who can automate stuff, analyze data with AI tools, and multiply their output.

This isn't about replacing humans. It's about humans with AI skills becoming unstoppable. The research shows companies are being pickier about who they hire. They want people who can hit the ground running and deliver from day one.

sections.heading: The AI Thing Is Real and It's Happening Now
sections.body:
I've been watching this stuff for years. Never seen a skill gap create this much opportunity this fast. People who get AI automation are writing their own tickets. They're getting promoted faster. Landing better roles. Becoming the go-to person in their company.

While the job market tightens everywhere else, it's wide open for people with AI skills. Companies need people who can use ChatGPT for strategy, Claude for analysis, and automation tools to make workflows run without them. These aren't tech jobs — they're every job, just enhanced with AI.

The future of work is getting written right now. The people learning this stuff today are gonna be the leaders tomorrow. Everyone else is gonna be playing catch-up for years.
